name: 凝岳沉目
prompt: Edit ONLY the eye pair in reference 1. Reference 2 is our game's face and is ONLY the painting style and facial-scale reference. User correction: each individual eye is horizontally TOO LONG. Repaint BOTH eyes into COMPACT adult male eyes. Shorten the actual eye aperture at BOTH the inner and outer ends towards its pupil, and remove the drawn-out outer-corner wing. Do NOT merely erase a lash tip while retaining an elongated eye. Preserve the centres and centre-to-centre spacing of the two pupils from reference 1; preserve the iris diameter, pupil diameter and vertical eye opening. Preserve vertical lid anatomy and natural short lashes. Do NOT scale down the whole pair or squish it horizontally. Shorten the painted anatomy itself, using shorter canthal reach, a softly rounded inner corner and a short natural outer corner with no eyeliner tail. Result must be distinctly less elongated, still appropriately open, never narrow slits or tiny eyes. Match our first-style finely painted warm charcoal ink edges, delicate smooth ink-wash tonal gradation, muted taupe-grey-brown irises, restrained off-white sclera, matte light and small symmetrical iris highlights. Preserve fine upper and a few lower natural eyelashes, not thick makeup. Return ONE isolated symmetrical level front-view eye pair on genuinely transparent background. ONLY eye organs, lids and faint translucent crease pigment; no eyebrows, no hair, no face, nose or opaque surrounding skin patches. No vector outlines, coarse grain, sharp triangular corners or anime. For this version, shorten each eye's total painted horizontal length by roughly 18–20 percent. Keep a gentle outer-corner lift and a light smooth upper lid, but the eye must be compact rather than a long phoenix or fox eye.
